pass_a_gloss: §29 dual gloss: κοιλία / belly · ἁγιάζω / be hallowed · ἕρπω / creep … Pass A ≠ Pass B. Theme: Every belly-creeper banned; be holy as Lord who led from Egypt.
pass_b_english: Cyril: 'And every creeping creeping upon the earth, an abomination this is; you will not eat from them. Everything walking upon belly, and everything walking upon four always, forever, as many as have many feet of all the creeping creeping upon the earth, you will not eat them, because an abomination they are. And you will not make your souls abominable in any creeping creeping, and you will not be defiled in them, and you will not become unclean in them. Because I am Lord your God, and you will be hallowed and you will be holy, because holy I am Lord your God; and you will not defile your souls in any of the creeping moving upon the earth. Because I am Lord the leading you up from land of Egypt to be your God; and you will be holy, because holy I am Lord.'
Palladius: The law seals holiness by separation from creeping manners.
Cyril: Creeping-upon-belly types those minding only earth; many-footed those unstable in every passion-path. God who led from Egypt demands holiness like his.
